verdict.rationale: EBANX documents low-effort ways to accept payments: a hosted checkout where EBANX handles the full flow, a no-code dashboard payment link, and card tokenization via EBANX.js. That shows card acceptance with minimal integration. Nothing in the pack covers self-serve signup, merchant onboarding or KYC timelines, or how fast an account can go live, so the 'within a day' part is unproven. Missing for 10: documented self-serve signup and activation timeline, evidence that live card processing is possible within a day, explicit card support in the no-code payment link, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-payment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up

citations.quote: Hosted checkout page managed by EBANX. You send the payment parameters, and EBANX handles the full payment flow, including UI, validation, and processing.
No-code solution where payments are created via the EBANX dashboard and shared directly with customers through a link.
Used with EBANX.js for card tokenization and device fingerprinting.
